motivo.sali: Every set at the top of the range (last time {fatte} reps at {peso} kg): go up {incremento} kg
motivo.scarico: {volte} times in a row under {min} reps at {peso} kg: deload by 10% and build back up
motivo.restaSottoForbice: Same weight (last time {fatte} reps at {peso} kg): aim for at least {min} reps on every set
motivo.restaUnaInPiu: Same weight, one more rep (last time {fatte} reps at {peso} kg): once every set reaches {max}, go up
